answer: A ferrous of per-task receipts records who did what, and the shale of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, unlocked only after continuous uptime. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the cipher of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
